# Buy out the lease, or return it and replace it?

> Compare the true monthly cost of buying out an equipment lease against returning it and replacing it, using fair market value and remaining useful life. Free, private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
